scope: IDEA000003, IDEA000008, IDEA000012, IDEA000017; logical/source review only

challenges.correction: The design permits pair-specific handoff roles, so leave-one-register-pair-out is not a valid transfer test unless a shared cross-pair rule or hierarchical pooling model is predeclared. A null can reject only the specified edge×pair interaction at adequate held-edge power; it cannot reject all handoff mechanisms.
challenges.required_discrimination: Predeclare saturated pair-specific, shared-effect, and hierarchical alternatives; require capacity and mobile endpoint gates before scoring. Report which ordered pairs have support and whether any effect transfers to an unseen pair.

challenges.issue: Generic class may be locally member-selective
challenges.correction: Held-panel success does not by itself distinguish an indexical pointer from a class code whose class is coextensive with one local member. The generic-class rival must include local member selection and can pass the current owner-transfer criterion.
challenges.required_discrimination: Cross contexts where the same class label has different independently adjudicated owners/items, or where multiple members share the class; compare exact item identity against proximity, section, and class controls. Owner transfer alone is insufficient.

challenges.issue: Positional opener and topic can coexist
challenges.correction: A record-initial positional opener may also introduce a topic. The current opener countermodel is not mutually exclusive with topic persistence, so continuity alone cannot adjudicate the mechanism.
challenges.required_discrimination: Test an added topic-persistence interaction conditional on opener position, record length, section, and host; independently mark topic changes and compare candidate wholes with structural openers. A null rejects only the added persistence effect.

challenges.correction: Definite and anaphoric uses can coexist for every noun or construction. A prior-mention cue-rate effect may be general discourse behavior, not a change in the candidate whole’s function.
challenges.required_discrimination: Estimate whole×prior-owner interaction against matched forms/owners/positions and an independently annotated cue process. The 70%/20-point thresholds test usage-conditioned reference behavior, not a lexical switch from definite to anaphoric.

These are genuine useful geometry observations. They are not independent
record targets: the inventory has no normalized second target locus and no
ordered inscription edge in any of the four channels.

1. **Authorial connectors between labeled endpoints.** Census all 61 pages on
   30 folios in the frozen permitted-annotation frame for visible arrows, lines,
   ducts, paths, or pointers whose two endpoint inscriptions can both be
   localized. This is the only primary route that directly matches the GDT387
   relation endpoint.
2. **Normalize local text-object relations.** The 95 current positives can
   support a separate object-relation endpoint after object IDs and ownership
   are normalized, but they may not be smuggled into the parent-link test.

No score is authorized until every frozen gate passes. In particular, capacity
must reach at least 50 singular directed edges on five folios, and the target
must remain mobile after matching. Confirmation planning should still prefer
the stronger GDT372 design of one to three external comparisons with many
complete arrays and multiple held folios.

The seven exact GDT217 page/key cells do not become seven references when
checked against the existing human catalogue.  Only **1/7** is independently
co-localized: f83r.51 (`darolsy`) is the lower label near the right structure
of the southwest figure, and f83r.52 starts the text block below that same
figure.  Their fixed source-family key is `CA` and the loci are consecutive.

Two cells are explicit counterexamples.  f75v links a top-pond label key to a
lower-pond paragraph key; f99v's `KA` cell links a row-1 plant label to the
bottom text block.  The remaining four cells have only page-level overlap or
mix labels from several visual units with prose lacking an exact owner.

The f83 local permutation diagnostic is also small: placing the observed `CA`
label key in the lower strict-label position occurs in **2/6** reassignments
(`p=0.3333`).  The other lower label, f83r.50, lacks a strict eligible
family value.  In the available HPR2 rows of f83r.52--55, exact host `arolsy`
occurs **0** times.  Exact `ol` occurs **4** times and
AR/AL-like states occur **4** times, but those are common
construction material, not a recovered content address.  HPR2 coverage is
complete for only **2/4** lines, so missing groups are not
negative evidence.

decision: All four proposals remain potentially testable only after these contrasts are made explicit. Existing endpoint evidence is insufficient for operative review; GDT388 requires at least 50 singular directed edges on five folios and mobile targets, while GDT220 demonstrates that local proximity can produce counterexamples.
